title: Science Corporation Reaches $3.5B Valuation After Funding
excerpt: Science Corporation has secured a $400 million Series D funding round to scale its anti-blindness technology.
body_html:
Science Corporation has completed a new funding round, bringing its total valuation to $3.5 billion. The company secured $400 million in a Series D financing round.

According to the details of the investment, the newly acquired capital will be used to scale up the operations of its anti-blindness business segment.
